task.question: Who was arrested in Germany on suspicion of complicity in the 1994 Rwandan genocide?
task.evidence: 1 July – Prosecutors in Hesse arrest a German–Rwandan national on suspicion of complicity in the 1994 Rwandan genocide.
task.sonnet_answer: Onesphore Rwabukombe was arrested in Germany on suspicion of complicity in the 1994 Rwandan genocide. He was tried in Frankfurt and convicted by a German court.
